## Summary

Update the usage guide so users who omit `--timeout` know how long a slow request can wait.

## Changes
The pull request raises the CLI’s default request timeout from 30 to 60 seconds, updates the parser test, and preserves explicit `--timeout` overrides. It also adds `review.txt`.
